page_title: STU 2-1 HOL | Stuttgart v Holstein Kiel 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Robert Hartmann is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Holstein Kiel have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' What a chance that is! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar!
88' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) picks up his second yellow card from referee Robert Hartmann and is given his marching orders.
87' Here is a change. Jamie Leweling is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart).

84' 2 - 1 Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the bottom right corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 2:1.
81' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
80' Today's match ends for Max Geschwill who will be replaced by Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel).
80' The referee shows the yellow card to Max Geschwill (Holstein Kiel).
80' Holstein Kiel have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
77' Holstein Kiel can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
77' The attendance is 59000.
71' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Hartmann had an easy-decision to make.
70' Marcel Rapp has decided to substitute Finn Porath and he is replaced by Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel).
70' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Deniz Undav.
70' Marcel Rapp has decided to make a change. Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) replaces Marvin Schulz.
70' A substitution has been made. Enzo Millot goes off and Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
66' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) has tested the patience of referee Robert Hartmann and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) receives a yellow card! It's his second one today, which means he will be send off!
66' A pass into the box finds Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alexander Nubel denies him.
63' A yellow card for a tackle by Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart). Robert Hartmann doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
62' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Fabian Rieder is replaced by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).
62' Here comes a substitution. El Bilal Toure is given a rest as he is replaced by Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart).

61' 2 - 0 What a beautiful moment! El Bilal Toure (VfB Stuttgart) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Timon Weiner just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:0.
59' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Timon Weiner, who smothers the ball.
58' Substitution. Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) has come on for Magnus Knudsen.
54' Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
54' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Stuttgart will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
51' Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) is booked by the referee.
46' Marcel Rapp makes a switch. Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) is coming on in place of Benedikt Pichler at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+2' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
41' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
39' The resulting set piece from Holstein Kiel is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

39' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.

38' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Stuttgart comes to nothing.
36' A cross from Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
31' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) was quite harsh and Robert Hartmann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
30' Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
30' Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Holstein Kiel earn a corner.
28' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
24' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
22' Stuttgart can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
19' 1 - 0 GOAL! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Timon Weiner, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:0.
17' El Bilal Toure (VfB Stuttgart) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar!
13' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.

13' Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top of the net. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Timon Weiner produces an easy save. Stuttgart have a corner.
10' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
9' The ball is cleared after Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' Stuttgart take a short corner kick.
4' Stuttgart are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
2' Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel) commits a rough foul. Robert Hartmann stops the game and makes a call.
